meta.title: AI Smart Cafe Builder
meta.description: Plan, design and build your cafe with one workspace. Match with designers and contractors, track every milestone.

hero.eyebrow: For cafe owners, designers and builders
hero.headline: Open your next cafe without losing a weekend to spreadsheets.
hero.sub: Post your brief, match a designer, line up a contractor. One workspace from first sketch to grand opening.
hero.hint: Free to plan, pay only when you accept a bid.

steps.label: Post
steps.title: Post the brief
steps.body: Square meters, style, budget and target customers. AI turns it into a shareable spec in under a minute.

steps.label: Match
steps.title: Pick your team
steps.body: Designers and contractors apply with real portfolios. Compare bids side by side and accept the ones that fit.

steps.label: Build
steps.title: Ship the cafe
steps.body: Designs, drawings, milestones, daily logs, issues and payments live in one timeline you can share with your crew.

why.title: Why cafe owners pick this over a WhatsApp group
why.subtitle: A workspace built around the questions cafe teams actually ask, not a generic project tracker.

tiles.title: AI brief in 60 seconds
tiles.body: Drop a few answers about your concept. The platform drafts the brief, suggests styles, and surfaces studios that match.

tiles.title: Designs with versions
tiles.body: Submit, review, request a revision, approve. Every round is timestamped and attributed, no more Final_v7_FINAL.jpg.

tiles.title: Drawings you can trust
tiles.body: Technical drawings live next to the designs they describe. Subcontractors pull measurements, not screenshots.

tiles.title: Milestones that report themselves
tiles.body: Site photos, daily logs, materials delivered, payments cleared. Each milestone page assembles the proof automatically.

roles.title: One workspace, three roles
roles.subtitle: Each side gets the surface they need. Everyone agrees on the timeline.

items.blurb: You post the brief, accept bids, and see every milestone from kickoff to ribbon cutting.
Apply for briefs, version your designs, hand off a clean drawing set to the contractor.
Quote the job, schedule phases, log daily progress, flag issues before they become delays.

finalCta.title: Your next cafe starts as a one-page brief.
finalCta.body: Skip the back-and-forth. Spin up a project, see who applies, and pick the team that fits.

footer.line: Built for cafe teams in HCMC, Hanoi and beyond.
